findings.title: refreshSession dereferences a missing session for an unknown token
findings.suggested_fix: Return null (or throw a typed error) when store.get(token) is undefined before touching expiresAt.
findings.why_it_matters: An expired or forged token makes the refresh endpoint throw a TypeError and return 500 instead of 401.
evidence: src/session.js:3 writes expiresAt with no guard

testing_gaps: No test covers an unknown token.
